name: example_provider_menu_configuration
description: Removes the native scheduling entry points: hides the Schedule item from the provider (hamburger) menu with a ProviderMenuConfiguration allow-list, hides the Appointments preset filter from the global panel with a PanelConfiguration allow-list, and moves the default landing page off the schedule page so providers are not stranded.

handlers.description: Allow-lists every provider menu item except Schedule.
Allow-lists every global panel section except Appointments.
Sends providers to the patients page on login instead of the schedule page.
